title: Deactivating Refusal Triggers: Understanding and Mitigating Overrefusal in Safety Alignment
reasoning: The paper investigates 'safety alignment' and 'overrefusal' in LLMs, which involves enforcing moral and ethical boundaries to prevent harmful outputs. It explicitly uses benchmarks like HEx-PHI and SorryBench to evaluate model behavior against ethical safety policies and references existing research on 'moral alignment' as a foundation for its mechanistic analysis.
